## Summary and General Analysis
- Herta's primary source of damage is her AoE Follow-Up ATK, which is triggered when any ally causes an enemy’s HP to fall below 50%. This Follow-Up ATK can only be performed 5 times at once, and any unused charges are stored until the next instance of an ally reducing an enemy’s HP below 50%.
- She has few cases outside of being a low-investment sub DPS option for The Herta, primarily in Pure Fiction. Thanks to her frequent attacks and her personal damage, she generates Energy decently well for The Herta while also helping to defeat enemies.
- She is a usable DPS in Pure Fiction, but gets held back by subpar damage multipliers from being an older 4-star.

## Notable Investments
 ### E2
- Her E2 provides 15% total CRIT Rate, allowing her to only need 85% before entering combat.

## Ability Rotation
- Skill spam, Basic ATK if needed
